# cor_flex

cor_flex

## Usage

``` r
cor_flex(x, ...)
```

## Arguments

- x:

  data to use

- ...:

  other arguments passed to stats::cor()

## Value

numeric

## Examples

``` r
m <- matrix(rnorm(100), nrow = 10)

cor_flex(m)
```
